variables.title: Instance load analysis
variables.log_evidence: The highlighted logs come from ${truth.finding} itself: peer instances remained healthy. Only this instance ran hot, so it's an outlier rather than a fleet-wide load problem.

demonstration.narration: I'll open this host's Logs tab to see what it recorded about the other instances while it ran hot.
demonstration.reasoning: A resource spike alone doesn't prove that customers were affected, or what caused it. Correlation tests the link: does another signal for the same entity change at the same time?
